gbm_population_evidence.quote: histologically proven high-grade glioma including GBM, anaplastic astrocytoma (AA), anaplastic oligodendroglioma (AO)

candidate_evidence.quote: This trial is designed to evaluate safety and explore possible efficacy of 5-aminolevulinic acid hydrochloride (5-ALA HCl, Gliolan®) with CV01 delivery of ultrasound for sonodynamic therapy
[DRUG] 5-Aminolevulinic acid Hydrochloride (Gliolan®): Patients will receive 5-Aminolevulinic acid hydrochloride via oral administration (20 mg/kg) 6-8 hours before CV01 treatment.

candidate_flag.reason: 5-ALA is used as a sonosensitiser activated by a focused-ultrasound device (drug-device sonodynamic therapy); the drug is pharmacological, but its antitumour effect depends on the device. Adjudicator to confirm it counts as a pharmacological candidate.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: in Patients With Newly Diagnosed High-Grade Glioma (HGG) Prior to Resection and Standard Adjuvant Therapy

flag.reason: 5-ALA is the only drug in the experimental arm but is combined with ultrasound (device), not with another antitumour drug or radiotherapy; standard radio-/chemotherapy follows resection outside the study intervention.

role_evidence.quote: Patients will receive sonodynamic therapy (5 ALA combined with CV01-delivered sonication) 2 to 5 days prior to standard resection.

agents.drug_class_hint: porphyrin precursor; fluorescence-guided surgery agent used here as sonosensitiser
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: sonodynamic therapy (5 ALA combined with CV01-delivered sonication)

flag.reason: New therapeutic use (sonodynamic) of an agent labelled for GBM visualisation; manual 4.2 says classify 5-ALA by the tree.

source_quote.quote: Anti-tumor activity assessed by Number of cells / mm³ with antibodies against IBA1 and Number of cells / mm³ with antibodies against Caspase III

flag.reason: Histopathological efficacy endpoint (microglia/macrophage and apoptosis markers); unclear whether it should be recorded as a molecular biomarker.

coder_notes: Phase 1 single-arm 5-ALA sonodynamic therapy with CV01 ultrasound before resection in newly diagnosed HGG including GBM (Univ. Münster; collaborator Alpheus Medical). Standard adjuvant radio-/chemotherapy is mentioned but no drug is named, so no SOC agent row.
